final_answer: The main mechanism behind the transformer architecture is the self-attention mechanism, which processes sequence data by computing relationships between tokens regardless of their positional distance. The self-attention mechanism allows the model to weigh the importance of each token in the sequence when making a prediction, leading to better performance across domains and tasks. The self-attention mechanism is a key component of transformer models and is responsible for their state-of-the-art performance.
